summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 4 new RPM Automotive features: mobile hamburger menu, Google Maps embed, SMS notification system (mocked), and full admin dashboard with authentication, lead management, client management, team management, and service tracking.
passed_tests: Backend API health check
Admin login with admin@rpm.com / admin123
Dashboard stats API returns correct data structure
Lead creation via /api/leads POST (public endpoint)
Lead retrieval via /api/leads GET (authenticated)
Lead conversion via /api/leads/{id}/convert POST
Lead status update via /api/leads/{id} PATCH
Lead deletion via /api/leads/{id} DELETE (admin only)
Client retrieval via /api/clients GET
Service record creation via /api/services POST
Team member retrieval via /api/team GET
Team member creation via /api/auth/register POST
Mobile hamburger menu toggle functionality
Mobile menu shows navigation links, language selector, and call CTA
Mobile menu opens and closes correctly at 390px width
Google Maps embed visible in contact section
Google Maps iframe has correct source URL for 110 Stanford Ave Santa Cruz CA
Contact form submission creates lead and triggers SMS notification (mocked)
Admin login page at /admin shows login form
Admin dashboard shows 6 stats cards (new leads, total leads, contacted, converted, clients, services)
Admin sidebar has Dashboard, Leads, Clients, Team navigation links
Admin leads page shows lead list with 5 status filters (all, new, contacted, converted, lost)
Lead detail panel shows phone, email, vehicle, service type, message, notes
Lead status can be updated via status buttons
Lead can be converted to client via Convert to Client button
Admin clients page shows client list with expandable service history
Service record can be added for a client via Add Service Record form
Admin team page shows team members with roles
Team member can be added by admin (name, email, password, role)
Admin logout functionality works correctly
Homepage still loads correctly with all sections after admin features
